string.text: {=taom_bv_dunland_threat_1}Halt, stranger. These hills were ours before the horse-lords ever rode through them, and every traveller pays us a toll. Silver now, or we take it from your pack.[rf:convo_mocking_revenge]
{=taom_bv_dunland_pay_agreement_1}Wise. We remember every road tax the valley lords ever took from us, so we take a little back. Name a price, and make it a kind one.[ib:hip][rf:convo_bemused]
{=taom_bv_dunland_conclusion_1}That keeps the fires lit through the winter. Go on, and tell the valley lords the hills still have owners.[ib:closed][rf:convo_bemused]
{=taom_bv_dunland_start_fight_1}Then the crows will have you. The hills remember who stood against them.[ib:aggressive][if:convo_annoyed]
{=taom_bv_dunland_threat_2}You walk the old drovers' road, and the old drovers' road is ours. Coin, or your blood in the heather. Choose quickly, the weather is turning.
{=taom_bv_dunland_pay_agreement_2}A trade, is it? Good. My kin are hungry, and hungry kin are not patient. What are you worth?[ib:hip][rf:convo_bemused]
{=taom_bv_dunland_conclusion_2}Fair dealing, for a stranger. Keep to the road, and the hills will let you pass this once.
{=taom_bv_dunland_start_fight_2}Brave, or foolish, and we have buried both. Show them what the hills do to trespassers.
{=taom_bv_dunland_greeting_harmless}We are only shepherds out of the hills, stranger, nothing worth your sword.
{=taom_bv_dunland_greeting_brothers}Best turn around, stranger. Half the clan waits in the heather behind those ridges, and they are not patient.
{=taom_bv_rhun_threat_1}Hold, stranger. This grass belongs to the riders of Rhûn, and every foot that crosses it owes a tribute. Silver, or we take it with your hide.[rf:convo_mocking_revenge]
{=taom_bv_rhun_pay_agreement_1}A trader's answer, good. Tell me what you carry, and whether you value your silver or your skin more.[ib:hip][rf:convo_bemused]
{=taom_bv_rhun_conclusion_1}The riders of Rhûn are satisfied. Go west, and say the grass was kind to you.[ib:closed][rf:convo_bemused]
{=taom_bv_rhun_start_fight_1}Then the grass will drink your blood, and my kin will sing of it. Ready yourself.[ib:aggressive][if:convo_bared_teeth]
{=taom_bv_rhun_threat_2}You stand far from the Sea of Rhûn, stranger, and far from any friend. Our bows are drawn and our patience is short. Leave your silver on the ground and keep walking.
{=taom_bv_rhun_pay_agreement_2}Sensible. A rider respects a traveller who counts the arrows before speaking. What do you offer?[ib:hip][rf:convo_bemused]
{=taom_bv_rhun_conclusion_2}Fair. The plains forget no debt, and neither do we. Ride on, and ride quickly.
{=taom_bv_rhun_start_fight_2}Then your name is lost to the wind. Sound the horns and loose the arrows.[ib:aggressive][if:convo_insulted]
{=taom_bv_rhun_greeting_harmless}We are only herders of the eastern grass, traveller, driving our horses to a fair. No threat to you.
{=taom_bv_rhun_greeting_brothers}Turn aside, stranger. Two hundred riders wait beyond that ridge for my signal, and their horses are hungry for a charge.
{=taom_bv_harad_threat_1}Slow your steps, traveller. The desert gives nothing for free, and the road through it is ours to sell. Pay the toll, or the sand will take the rest.
{=taom_bv_harad_pay_agreement_1}A wise answer. Water costs less than blood, and so does passage. Name your price, and make it generous.[ib:hip][rf:convo_bemused]
{=taom_bv_harad_conclusion_1}The sun smiles on you today. Go in peace, and tell others the southern road has keepers.[ib:closed][rf:convo_bemused]
{=taom_bv_harad_start_fight_1}Then the vultures will feast before sunset. Raise the spears.[ib:aggressive][if:convo_annoyed]
{=taom_bv_harad_threat_2}Well met, stranger of the long road. We have walked long between wells, and you look well supplied. Your silver and your waterskins, or we take everything you own.
{=taom_bv_harad_pay_agreement_2}Good. Bargaining is the breath of the south. Show me what you carry, and we will find the number together.[ib:hip][rf:convo_bemused]
{=taom_bv_harad_conclusion_2}A fair bargain. May your road be short and your skin stay cool. We will remember your face.[ib:closed]
{=taom_bv_harad_start_fight_2}So you choose the sword. The dunes have swallowed greater hosts than yours.
{=taom_bv_harad_greeting_harmless}Only nomads of the southern sands, traveller. We mean no harm to anyone.
{=taom_bv_harad_greeting_brothers}Be warned, traveller. The whole warband rests in the next wadi, spears ready, waiting for a single signal from us.
{=taom_bv_gundabad_threat_1}Stop, maggot! This is Gundabad's road. You pay us, or we gnaw your bones on it. Silver first, then we decide about the rest.[rf:convo_angry]
{=taom_bv_gundabad_pay_agreement_1}Heh. Smart, maggot. Smarter than the last one. Empty your pockets and we count. Quick![ib:hip][rf:convo_angry]
{=taom_bv_gundabad_conclusion_1}Enough. Go. Run before we change our minds. Gundabad is still hungry.[ib:closed]
{=taom_bv_gundabad_start_fight_1}Good! The pack has not eaten since the last snowfall. Tear them apart![ib:aggressive][if:convo_bared_teeth]
{=taom_bv_gundabad_threat_2}Hold, meat on legs. The Mountain claims all that crosses it, and we are the Mountain's teeth. Coin and trinkets, whatever shines, or teeth.
{=taom_bv_gundabad_pay_agreement_2}Talk, talk. Fine. How much shiny? Show us, and be fast, the cold makes us cruel.[ib:hip][rf:convo_angry]
{=taom_bv_gundabad_conclusion_2}Keep walking, meat. The next pack may not be so kind. Or so full.
{=taom_bv_gundabad_start_fight_2}Ha! Fresh meat and a fight, the best kind of day. Kill them all.
{=taom_bv_gundabad_greeting_harmless}Just hunters, you. Hunting rabbits. Only rabbits. Nothing to worry about, heh.
{=taom_bv_gundabad_greeting_brothers}Back off, maggot. The whole warren waits in the rocks above you, hungry, waiting for a signal.
{=taom_bv_umbar_threat_1}Ho there, you on the road! We came ashore to fill our holds, and you look like the first cargo. Silver now, and we part without a scratch.[rf:convo_mocking_revenge]
{=taom_bv_umbar_pay_agreement_1}Good. Even a landlubber can read the tide. Name an offer, and quickly, before the captain loses patience.[ib:hip][rf:convo_bemused]
{=taom_bv_umbar_conclusion_1}Fair winds to you. A share is a share, and Umbar remembers a fair deal.[ib:closed][rf:convo_bemused]
{=taom_bv_umbar_start_fight_1}Then we board you the old way. Blades out, and take what the sea has not.[ib:aggressive][if:convo_annoyed]
{=taom_bv_umbar_threat_2}Black sails are far off, traveller, but black blades are close. The corsairs of Umbar claim every road they walk. Pay the landing fee, or we take it from your pack.
{=taom_bv_umbar_pay_agreement_2}Aye, we can talk. Even a pirate prefers a full purse to a bloody deck. What is your offer?[ib:hip][rf:convo_bemused]
{=taom_bv_umbar_conclusion_2}A pleasure doing business. Mind the road, and mind the sea if you are fool enough to sail it.
{=taom_bv_umbar_start_fight_2}Mutiny against good sense, and I will not bargain with it. We sink you where you stand.[ib:aggressive][if:convo_insulted]
{=taom_bv_umbar_greeting_harmless}Honest merchants of Umbar, traveller, ashore to stretch our legs and mend a sail. No trouble here.
{=taom_bv_umbar_greeting_brothers}Mind yourself, traveller. Our ships lie in the next cove with three hundred blades aboard, waiting for our signal.

{=taom_bv_gondor_threat_1}Stand where you are, traveller. We wore the White Tree once and bled for it, and what did it pay us? Silver for the road, and we need not make this ugly.[rf:convo_mocking_revenge]
{=taom_bv_gondor_pay_agreement_1}Thank you. I mean it, and I hate that I do. Name an offer. We have not eaten properly in a week.[ib:hip][rf:convo_bemused]
{=taom_bv_gondor_conclusion_1}May the Valar forgive us both. Go, and do not tell the garrison you saw us.[ib:closed]

{=taom_bv_gondor_start_fight_1}Then it is steel, and I am sorry for it. We have fought worse odds than yours and lost our honour long ago. There is little left to lose.[ib:aggressive][if:convo_very_stern]
{=taom_bv_gondor_threat_2}Halt. We marched these roads under the Steward's banner before the pay stopped coming. Now we collect our wages from travellers. Pay up.
{=taom_bv_gondor_pay_agreement_2}Sensible. Believe me, none of us wants a fight. We have buried enough comrades. What can you give?[ib:hip][rf:convo_bemused]
{=taom_bv_gondor_conclusion_2}That feeds us until the first frost. You are kinder than the Steward ever was to us. Go on, and keep your head down.
{=taom_bv_gondor_start_fight_2}So be it. Form up, as we were taught. If this is the end, it is at least a soldier's end.[ib:aggressive][if:convo_annoyed]
{=taom_bv_gondor_greeting_harmless}Only a patrol of the Steward's guard, traveller, resting on the way. Nothing here to concern you.
{=taom_bv_gondor_greeting_brothers}Do not try us. The rest of the company is dug in on that hill, bows strung, and they answer to our signal and no one else's.

{=taom_bv_erebor_threat_1}Hold, stranger! This pass was cut by dwarven hands, and all who walk it pay the maker's toll. Gold, or the axe. We prefer gold, but we are not particular.[rf:convo_mocking_revenge]
{=taom_bv_erebor_pay_agreement_1}A sensible answer, for a stranger. Gold speaks every tongue. Show us what you carry, and count it honestly.[ib:hip][rf:convo_bemused]
{=taom_bv_erebor_conclusion_1}A fair toll, honestly paid. The mountain remembers it. Go on, and keep clear of our halls.[ib:closed][rf:convo_bemused]
{=taom_bv_erebor_start_fight_1}Then we settle this the dwarven way. Axes up! Let the mountain hear it.[ib:aggressive][if:convo_bared_teeth]
{=taom_bv_erebor_threat_2}Stop where you are. Our clan was cast out of its halls and left with little more than our axes and a long memory. The road is all the hall we have, and you owe it rent.
{=taom_bv_erebor_pay_agreement_2}Hm. Reasonable. Few travellers bargain before the axes come out. What are you offering?[ib:hip][rf:convo_bemused]
{=taom_bv_erebor_conclusion_2}Paid in full. We never forget a debt, nor a debtor. Go well, and spread the word: the road has a rent now.
{=taom_bv_erebor_start_fight_2}Then you go in the ledger of grudges. Axes ready![ib:aggressive][if:convo_annoyed]
{=taom_bv_erebor_greeting_harmless}Only miners and smiths, traveller, heading home with our tools. We want no trouble.
{=taom_bv_erebor_greeting_brothers}Think twice, stranger. The rest of the clan waits behind that hill, axes sharp and tempers shorter, waiting for our signal.
{=taom_bv_mirkwood_threat_1}Quietly now. The trees have counted your steps for the last hour, and so have we. Leave your silver on the moss and walk on.[rf:convo_mocking_revenge]
{=taom_bv_mirkwood_pay_agreement_1}Wise. The Wood has little patience for the loud, and less for the stubborn. Show us what you carry.[ib:hip][rf:convo_bemused]
{=taom_bv_mirkwood_conclusion_1}The Wood is content. Keep to the path, stranger, and do not look back at the shadows. They are not all ours.[ib:closed]
{=taom_bv_mirkwood_start_fight_1}The arrows are already nocked. You were never alone out here.[ib:aggressive][if:convo_very_stern]
{=taom_bv_mirkwood_threat_2}Do not reach for your sword. Bowstrings are drawn on you from five trees at once, and not one of us has blinked. Your silver for your life.
{=taom_bv_mirkwood_pay_agreement_2}A calm answer in a dark place. We respect that. Name an offer, and keep your hands where we can see them.[ib:hip][rf:convo_bemused]
{=taom_bv_mirkwood_conclusion_2}Done. The Wood forgets you now. Walk on, and walk quietly, because other things here do not bargain.
{=taom_bv_mirkwood_start_fight_2}Then the Wood keeps you. Loose![ib:aggressive][if:convo_annoyed]
{=taom_bv_mirkwood_greeting_harmless}Only foresters, traveller, out gathering firewood. Nothing to fear from us.
{=taom_bv_mirkwood_greeting_brothers}I would turn back, stranger. A hundred bows are already trained on you from the branches, waiting for our signal.
